title: systemd Service Fails to Start (CrashLoop)
symptom: `systemctl start myapp` fails with 'Job for myapp.service failed because the control process exited with error code'.
initial_observations: Service status shows Active: failed (Result: exit-code).
Main PID exited with error code (status=1/FAILURE or status=127).

possible_causes.cause: Address already in use (another process already listening on the configured port)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: journalctl shows 'bind: Address already in use' or 'EADDRINUSE'.
possible_causes.remediation: Identify conflicting process using `ss -tlnp` and stop it or adjust configuration port.

possible_causes.cause: Missing executable or wrong path specified in ExecStart directive (exit status 127)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: journalctl shows 'Failed at step EXEC spawning ...: No such file or directory'.
possible_causes.remediation: Update ExecStart path in unit file to the absolute path of the verified binary, run daemon-reload.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Service Status and Exit Reason
investigation_steps.explanation: Check unit state, PID, exit code, and recent log snippets.

investigation_steps.title: Review Full Unit Journal Logs
investigation_steps.explanation: View stdout/stderr emitted by the service process before death.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Stack traces, missing config files, or port binding errors.

prevention: Validate configuration files before restarting systemd services.
Use `systemctl daemon-reload` whenever unit files are edited.
